def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)

def run(name, command, cwd=game, expected_exit=0, timeout=30, clean=True):
    started = time.monotonic()
    completed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
    check = {
        'name': name, 'command': [str(item) for item in command], 'cwd': str(cwd),
        'exit_status': completed.returncode, 'expected_exit_status': expected_exit,
        'elapsed_seconds': round(time.monotonic() - started, 3),
        'stdout': completed.stdout, 'stderr': completed.stderr,
    }
    record['checks'].append(check)
    save()
    require(completed.returncode == expected_exit, f'{name}: unexpected exit {completed.returncode}')
    if clean:
        require(not completed.stderr.strip(), f'{name}: unexpected stderr')
        require(not re.search(r'(?m)^(?:SCRIPT ERROR|ERROR|WARNING):', completed.stdout), f'{name}: engine diagnostic')
    print(f'PASS: {name} ({check["elapsed_seconds"]}s)', flush=True)
    return check

def events(check, event):
    return [item for line in check['stdout'].splitlines() if line.startswith('{')
            for item in [json.loads(line)] if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get('event') == event]

    require(ready[0]['role'] == 'server' and ready[0]['audio_driver'] == 'Dummy', 'Wrong role/audio')
    require([item['iteration'] for item in events(check, 'server-heartbeat')] == [1, 2, 3], 'Heartbeats were not executed')
    smoke = events(check, 'server-smoke')
    require(smoke == [{'event': 'server-smoke', 'heartbeat_count': 3, 'result': 'Passed'}], 'No passing smoke')
    probes = events(check, 'server-bootstrap-check')
    require(len(probes) == 2, 'Expected startup and final scene checks')
    for probe in probes:
        require(probe['result'] == 'Passed' and probe['local_player_count'] == 0, 'Nonempty player tree')
        require(not probe['client_scene_loaded'] and not probe['unexpected_nodes'], 'Client or extra node present')
        require(probe['scene_nodes'] == ['/root/ServerRoot', '/root/ServerRoot/BootstrapHeartbeat'], 'Wrong tree')
    return ready[0]

review.scope_and_requirements: Passed: T03 only; bootstrap selects a dedicated Node scene and reuses the locked launcher. T02 client behavior remains covered by default/explicit scene probes and connected Quit signal. No engine/config/renderer pin was changed.
review.ownership_and_abstractions: Passed: bootstrap owns command-line role/scene composition; typed server configuration owns JSON-to-version parsing; server scene owns its Timer, checks and liveness. The small configuration object isolates the dynamic file boundary from scene behavior. No new global, manager, service, domain schema or duplicated rules.
review.responsibility_review: Passed: the argument parser exceeds roughly 40 logical lines but performs one cohesive boundary parse and validates role-specific preconditions. Further extraction would split a single small command contract. No script approaches 300 logical lines.
review.types_and_resources: Passed: typed GDScript methods/fields/collections; validated local JSON Variant; no casts/reflection/warning suppressions. Timer is an owned child with an explicit signal; engine-generated script UIDs are retained. No project, client scene, icon or unrelated asset edits.
review.lifecycle: Passed: bootstrap removes itself before attaching the configured server and defers startup until current_scene is set. Smoke executes both tree checks and the actual Timer. Ctrl+C and timeout checks leave no owned child. Shared per-player resources and asynchronous network callbacks are N/A because none exist.
review.security_and_authority: Passed for local startup boundary: missing/malformed/duplicate CLI and invalid version labels are rejected, no raw config dumps, no credentials, transport, accounts or database. Full config policy remains T04. Authenticated connection, replay/replication and multi-peer tests are N/A: no networking was added.
review.validation: Passed: 25 actual executions, canonical fixture schema validation, Python compile, GDScript parsing and engine-log inspection. Historical restricted-session diagnostics and one invalid test setup are retained separately. GUI/export/gameplay checks not run and not claimed.
review.git_and_instruction_safety: Passed: both repositories began clean. No Git commits, branches, pushes, PRs, deployments or protected standards edits. mmo_docs progress/evidence/generated edits are explicitly required by the user-invoked workspace execute-ticket skill. Owned temporary copies were cleaned; existing game import state was preserved.
review.completion: All four ticket criteria have current passing evidence and T02 is Complete. Parent BW-001 remains In Progress. Documentation command outcomes are retained separately in documentation-checks.json.
review.final_source_hash_check: Passed: recomputed every recorded game-file SHA-256 against the final source; zero mismatches.
